stem:
Veena draws two rays from a common point O on her slate: ray OA and ray OB.

Which statement correctly describes the angle they form?

options.text: The vertex of the angle is arm OA.
OA and OB form this angle even if they start at two different points.
The rays share starting point O (the vertex); the arms are OA and OB; the angle may be named ∠AOB.
The angle is named ∠O because O is the first letter printed on the slate.

teacher.key_rationale: An angle is two rays with a common starting point. That point is the vertex; the rays are the arms; a three-letter name places the vertex in the middle (∠AOB).
